name: process_native_pdf_tool
description: Inspect a PDF's native text, coordinates, image/vector objects, and tagged-PDF structure before rendering. Returns a page plan that routes each page to native_pdf, textract_ocr, hybrid, or vision_ai and saves schema-valid native BADGERS spines for usable pages.

document_path.description: S3 URL (s3://bucket/key) or absolute path to a PDF document.

result.description: JSON page plan with routes, native fidelity, evidence, and native_output_uri for every page.

page_plan_uri.description: S3 URI of the durable page plan.
